battle.name: 公元161-166年羅馬-安息戰爭
battle.theater: 美索不達米亞與亞美尼亞
battle.brief: 161年，馬爾庫斯·奧勒留因亞美尼亞王位與哈特拉歸屬爭端派使節，使節被扣害，羅馬開戰。162至163年，科爾布羅與卡西烏斯相繼攻入底格里斯河谷、奪泰西封，兩度攻不下深壕高牆的哈特拉；164年辛加拉之戰羅軍得手，165年因瘟疫與多瑙河戰線東返，166年安息求和，羅馬退回幼發拉底河。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 羅馬一方是安東尼王朝治下的羅馬帝國。皇帝馬爾庫斯·奧勒留自161年起與其兄弟盧基烏斯·維魯斯共治，東線的實權握在皇帝直派、任期短命的將領手裡：卡帕多西亞總督格奈烏斯·多米提烏斯·科爾布羅打頭，接著是阿維迪烏斯·卡西烏斯、圖利烏斯·克里普利努斯，直到165年由普布利烏斯·馬爾提烏斯·維魯斯收拾殘局。兵員以卡帕多西亞、敘利亞兩區的野戰軍為骨架，第三高盧軍團、第七軍團、第十二軍團與第一敏神軍團等主力軍團是攻堅與駐防的骨幹，輔以敘利亞、阿拉伯與巴勒斯坦的弓兵、輕裝步兵、輔助騎兵，以及卡帕多西亞自圖拉真時代便保留下來的攻城工匠與器材。戰區後方設於卡帕多西亞、亞美尼亞與安條克，補給線沿幼發拉底河與底格里斯河的水陸轉運維持。安息一方是阿爾薩契德王朝的帕提亞帝國，奧斯羅斯一世坐鎮泰西封，握美索不達米亞農田、波斯灣商路與伊朗高原西部的兵源稅賦；其軍隊核心是重裝弓騎兵與長槍騎兵，另有大批波斯與伊拉克弓手，附屬國則是亞美尼亞、哈特拉、索費尼與阿迪亞貝尼。誰能決定這四個附屬國的歸屬，誰就決定了這場戰爭的走向。
countriesEn: The Roman side was the Roman Empire under the Antonine dynasty. From 161 the emperor Marcus Aurelius ruled jointly with his brother Lucius Verus, but real power over the eastern front rested with a series of imperial appointees whose commands were short: Gnaeus Domitius Corbulo, governor of Cappadocia, set the pace; Avidius Cassius and Tullius Crispinus followed; and in 165 Publius Martius Verus was left to pick up the pieces. The manpower came from the field armies of Cappadocia and Syria, with III Gallica, VII Claudia, XII Fulminata and I Minervia forming the backbone of sieges and garrison duty, supplemented by archers, light infantry and auxiliary cavalry drawn from Syria, Arabia and Palestine, together with the engineers and siege material that Cappadocia had kept since the days of Trajan. The rear areas lay in Cappadocia, Armenia and Antioch, and the supply lines ran by water and land along the Euphrates and the Tigris. The other side was the Arsacid Parthian Empire: Osroes I sat at Ctesiphon, holding the farmland of Mesopotamia, the trade routes of the Persian Gulf and the men and taxes of western Iran. The core of its army was armoured horse-archers and lancers, supported by large numbers of Persian and Iraqi archers, and its client states were Armenia, Hatra, Sophene and Adiabene. Whoever decided which of those four client states belonged to whom decided the course of this war.
people: 能左右戰局的，幾乎都是皇帝身邊的人。馬爾庫斯·奧勒留在163年親率大軍抵達底格里斯河谷，圍塞琉西亞，入泰西封，又兩度進攻哈特拉，最後因瘟疫與北方多瑙曼尼人西進而被迫西行；他的兄弟盧基烏斯·維魯斯留在羅馬，這場戰爭因此不是兩位皇帝各打一場，而是皇帝一人在前線的賭注。老將科爾布羅是最鋒利的一把刀：161年奉召回來即攻入亞美尼亞，奪其都阿爾塔克薩塔，逼瓦洛加塞斯出走，隨後在162年西行途中於尼西亞附近猝死，傳說是遭自己人下毒，疑點至今未解；他一死，亞美尼亞的戰果便再無人收拾。卡西烏斯是另一個關鍵人物：163年奉命接替，指揮攻城時在哈特拉受傷退下，164年卻在敘利亞被部下推舉稱帝，165年進軍卡帕多西亞時在里西亞的布邦被皇帝派出的追兵擊殺，兒子與女婿同死；叛亂期間安息趁機反攻敘利亞與小亞細亞東岸，東線頓時崩解。另一端，奧斯羅斯一世改立亞美尼亞王、扣押並殺害羅馬使節卡皮托，是開戰的導火線；最後主持和談的馬爾提烏斯·維魯斯，把戰爭收束在六年的框框裡。隨軍的卡西烏斯·狄奧留下的記述，是今日所知這場戰爭最詳細的戰地記錄。
peopleEn: Almost everyone who shaped the outcome of this war stood close to the emperor. Marcus Aurelius led the great army into the Tigris valley himself in 163, ringed Seleucia, entered Ctesiphon, assaulted Hatra twice, and finally had to march west because of the plague and the westward push of the Marcomanni beyond the Danube; his brother Lucius Verus stayed in Rome, so this was not two emperors each fighting a war but one emperor staking everything on a single front. The veteran Corbulo was the sharpest blade available: recalled in 161, he drove straight into Armenia, took its capital Artaxata and drove Vologases out, then died suddenly on the road back west near Nicaea in 162 — the story that he was poisoned by his own men has never been settled, and after his death nobody was left to consolidate what he had won in Armenia. Cassius was the other pivotal figure: appointed in 161 to take over, he was wounded at Hatra and withdrew, yet in 164 his troops in Syria acclaimed him emperor; advancing on Cappadocia in 165 he was destroyed with his son and son-in-law by detachments sent by the emperor at Bubon in Lycia, and while the rebellion ran its course the Parthians counter-attacked Syria and the eastern coast of Asia Minor, and the eastern front came apart. On the other side, Osroes I changed the king of Armenia and detained and killed the Roman legate Capito, which set the war off; Publius Martius Verus, who finally conducted the peace talks, closed the affair inside a six-year frame. The account left behind by Cassius Dio, who was with the army, remains the most detailed field record of this war that we possess.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓，是全場最貼題的裝備。公元前七世紀的亞述弓形制短小、弓臂反曲、以角為背，是兩河流域弓術的源頭；同一條譜系一路傳到安息人手中，成為帕提亞弓騎兵的核心武器：騎在馬上拉弓，全憑手腕與身體配合，射速高、箭道平而低，能在數十步內連續覆蓋一片縱深。卡面標的是亞述，講的其實是這條技術譜系在東方的兩端：安息人把它推到極致，羅馬則靠敘利亞、阿拉伯與巴勒斯坦的輔助弓兵，把同一套兩河流域弓術收編進東方戰區，替投石機與攻城塔作掩護。安息方面另有重甲馬具、札甲與鱗甲、長矛、雙刃短劍與砍刀、標槍，以及成建制用來打散羅軍縱深的騎兵團；羅馬方面則是重型標槍、方盾與鎖子甲，配卡帕多西亞的破城槌、擲石機、弩砲、雲梯與壕壘器械。補給面靠駱駝隊與河船：底格里斯河是這場戰爭的補給主軸，軍隊一旦離開河道深入北方荒原，糧秣立刻吃緊。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on this card is the piece of equipment most directly at issue in the campaign. The Assyrian bow of the seventh century BC was short, recurved in the limbs and backed with horn, the fountainhead of the archery tradition of Mesopotamia; the same lineage ran straight into the hands of the Parthians and became the core weapon of their horse-archers: shooting from the saddle, the whole effort worked through wrist and body, the rate of fire was high and the arrow flew low and flat, so that a stretch of the enemy's depth could be blanketed again and again at a few tens of paces. The card is labelled Assyrian, but what it really records is the two ends of that same technical line in the East: the Parthians pushed it to its limit, while Rome recruited the archers of Syria, Arabia and Palestine into the eastern war zone and turned the same Mesopotamian archery tradition into covering fire for ballistae and siege towers. On the Parthian side the kit also included heavy horse harness, scale and lamellar armour, lances, short double-edged swords and sagaris, javelins, and formed bodies of cavalry used to break up the Roman columns. On the Roman side were the heavy pilum, the rectangular scutum and mail, together with the Cappadocian battering ram, onager, ballista, ladders and the tools for entrenchments. On the logistics side, the campaign rode on camel trains and river boats: the Tigris was the main artery of supply, and the moment an army left the river and pushed into the barren country to the north, the food ran short.
tactics: 安息的戰法是一貫的不接戰：正面只以少量步兵與羅軍周旋，主力弓騎兵在兩翼拉開距離，射完一輪即退，若羅軍追擊便再退再射，靠的是馬力與箭的雙重消耗，不肯把重騎兵押在一次撞角上；圍城時他們切糧道、夜襲營地、燒田逼糧，不求速決。哈特拉守軍走的又是另一條路：深壕高牆，固守待援，安息援軍一到便直撲圍城者的側翼與輜重，兩度解圍。羅馬這邊，馬爾庫斯·奧勒留在這一役前後把新裝備推到前線：從北行省徵調的槍騎兵（持長矛的重裝騎兵）用長槍迎擊安息重甲騎兵，另有攜槍步兵試圖以投射兵器削弱對方縱深；步兵仍靠密集陣與塔樓雲梯攻堅，但攻城器械一離開河運便難以補給，整場戰爭的節奏因此被河流水位與糧道決定。
tacticsEn: The Parthian way of fighting was consistently to avoid contact: only a small body of infantry would parry with the Romans in the front while the main mass of horse-archers kept their distance on both wings, loosed a volley and then pulled away, and if the Romans followed they would shoot again from the retreat, wearing the enemy down with horseflesh and arrows alike, refusing to commit the heavy cavalry to a single charge. In the siege they cut supply lines, raided the camps at night and burned the fields to starve the garrison, and they were in no hurry. The defence of Hatra followed yet another path: deep ditch and high wall, hold and wait, and when the Parthian relief army arrived it fell on the flank and the baggage of the besiegers, and it lifted the siege twice. On the Roman side Marcus Aurelius pushed new equipment to the front around this campaign: lancers — heavy cavalry armed with the long contus — were raised from the northern provinces and matched the armoured Parthian horse with the long spear, while javelin-throwing infantry were tried out to thin the enemy's depth. The infantry still assaulted with the close-packed formation, towers and ladders, but siege machines were hard to supply once separated from the river, so the rhythm of the whole war was decided by river levels and by the grain route.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但有幾個節點相當確定。戰爭自161年打到166年，前後六年。哈特拉被圍兩次：163年卡西烏斯圍城受傷而退，164年馬爾庫斯·奧勒留親自督攻仍不能下；上一回有明確兵力記載的要退到圖拉真116年攻哈特拉，羅軍所部約兩萬。塞琉西亞與泰西封隔底格里斯河相望，直線距離不足三公里，兩城都是安息經營已久的要塞，其中一城一旦失守，另一城隨即暴露。卡西烏斯164年在敘利亞稱帝、165年在布邦被殞，叛亂壽命約一年。165年自東方戰線傳入的疫病，隨後蔓延到帝國全境，成了安東尼瘟疫的開端。關於兩軍的具體死傷數字，古典作家留下的是零星而互相矛盾的估算，宜看作量級而不是帳目。
dataEn: Verifiable figures are scarce, but a few landmarks are solid. The war ran from 161 to 166, six years in all. Hatra was besieged twice: in 163 Cassius was wounded and withdrew, and in 164 Marcus Aurelius supervised the siege in person and still could not take it; the last siege for which a clear troop figure survives is Trajan's attack on Hatra in 116, when the Roman force numbered about twenty thousand men. Seleucia and Ctesiphon faced each other across the Tigris less than three kilometres apart, both being fortresses the Parthians had long developed, so that once one of them fell the other was immediately exposed. Cassius was acclaimed emperor in Syria in 164 and killed at Bubon in 165, a rebellion that lasted about a year. The plague that came back with the eastern army in 165 spread through the empire and marked the beginning of the Antonine Plague. On the exact casualty figures of the two sides, the ancient writers left scattered and mutually contradictory estimates; they are better read as orders of magnitude than as accounts.
cause: 直接原因是一連串的附屬王國糾紛。亞美尼亞王位空懸時，奧斯羅斯一世先把羅馬所立的王逐走，改立自己人，哈特拉、索費尼與阿迪亞貝尼三處的效忠對象也重新排列；馬爾庫斯·奧勒留不能容忍帝國邊緣的附庸改換主人，161年派出以塞普蒂米烏斯·克拉魯斯為首的使團，要求歸還亞美尼亞王位與三處附屬國。安息扣押使節團，傳記稱卡皮托被殺，羅馬使節有去無回，談判就此破裂，戰爭隨之開打。更深一層的原因是結構性的：圖拉真117年雖然一度奪下泰西封、深入波斯灣沿岸，卻未能把美索不達米亞真正變成羅馬的省份，這片河谷與商路仍屬安息；兩國在邊境、附屬國與稅源上長期摩挲，羅馬要的是安息稱臣退讓，安息要的是羅馬承認既成事實。加上安息宮廷內部本身就有王族與地方貴族角力，亞美尼亞是最方便的著力點。
causeEn: The immediate cause was a cluster of disputes over client kingdoms. When the throne of Armenia fell vacant, Osroes I first expelled the king installed by Rome and substituted his own man, and the loyalties of Hatra, Sophene and Adiabene were rearranged along with him. Marcus Aurelius could not tolerate a client of the empire's frontier changing masters, and in 161 he sent an embassy headed by Septimius Clarus demanding the return of the Armenian king and of those three client states. The Parthians detained the embassy, and the record says Capito was killed; the Roman envoys went in and did not come out, the negotiations broke down, and war followed. The deeper causes were structural: although Trajan had seized Ctesiphon in 117 and pushed as far as the shore of the Persian Gulf, he had never turned Mesopotamia into a Roman province, and that valley and its trade routes remained Parthian. The two empires had rubbed along their frontier, over client states and over tax rights, for years; Rome wanted the Parthians to acknowledge its supremacy and give ground, while Parthia wanted Rome to ratify the fait accompli. And within the Parthian court itself the royal house and the provincial nobility were pulling against one another, which made Armenia the most convenient point of leverage.
impact: 短期看，這場戰爭誰也沒得到想要的東西：羅馬沒能留下美索不達米亞的省份，安息沒能讓亞美尼亞脫離自己的棋盤，雙方邊界大致回到161年前的樣子。真正留下痕跡的是三件事。第一，哈特拉守住了，它從此以獨立附屬國的身份坐大，在往後兩百多年裡成為強權爭奪的目標；第二，165年自東方戰線帶回的疫病迅速席捲帝國，安東尼瘟疫動搖了人口與財政，這場戰爭是它在歐洲的開場；第三，163年敗於哈特拉、164年又捲入卡西烏斯叛亂，說明羅馬在東方必須由皇帝常駐前線才能運作，而皇帝一旦被多瑙河牽住，東線就自動癱瘓。軍術層面的後果更持久：安息弓騎兵樹立了不可正面交鋒的對手典範，羅馬因此在這一役推動騎兵改革，槍騎兵與攜槍步兵這些新兵種此後數十年在東方防線上扮演主角，薩珊帝國崛起時，接手的正是這套改良後的騎兵。
impactEn: In the short term neither side got what it wanted: Rome kept no province in Mesopotamia, Parthia did not tear Armenia out of its own orbit, and the frontier ended up roughly where it had stood in 161. Three consequences were of longer life. First, Hatra held, and from then on it grew as an independent client state and remained an object of contention between powers for more than two centuries. Second, the plague that came back with the eastern army in 165 spread fast through the empire; the Antonine Plague shook the population and the finances, and this war was its curtain-raiser in Europe. Third, the failure at Hatra in 163 and the Cassius rebellion of 164 showed that Rome could only run its eastern front with the emperor personally in the theatre, and that the moment the emperor was tied down on the Danube the eastern front collapsed by itself. The military consequences endure longest: the Parthian horse-archers set the model of an enemy who must not be met head-on, and Rome's answer was the cavalry reform of this campaign — lancers and javelin-throwing infantry, which for decades afterwards held the eastern frontier and which the rising Sasanian state would meet in its improved form.
result: 166年，和談在馬爾提烏斯·維魯斯主持下達成。奧斯羅斯一世同意撤出亞美尼亞，把哈特拉、索費尼與阿迪亞貝尼交還羅馬原本的附屬體系，交付人質，並以金銀支付一筆數目可觀的戰爭賠償；羅馬則歸還所佔城邑與俘獲物，承認亞美尼亞歸於安息所立的瓦洛加塞斯，軍隊自底格里斯河谷與泰西封一帶撤出，邊界退到幼發拉底河為止。整場戰爭至此結束，帝國的軍力重心隨即轉向多瑙河。史家可以說羅馬又勝一場，但從戰略成果看，雙方其實各自退回原點：羅馬保住了卡帕多西亞的屏藩，安息保住了亞美尼亞的宗主權，誰都沒有拿到河谷。安息弓騎兵仍然橫行於底格里斯河與幼發拉底河之間，羅馬則學會了不與正面交鋒，這才是這場戰爭留下的真正教材。
resultEn: In 166 the peace was concluded under Publius Martius Verus. Osroes I agreed to withdraw from Armenia, to hand Hatra, Sophene and Adiabene back to the client systems Rome had claimed, to give hostages, and to pay a considerable war indemnity in gold and silver; Rome in return gave back the towns it occupied and the booty it had taken, recognised Armenia under the Vologases raised by the Parthians, and pulled its armies out of the Tigris valley and the neighbourhood of Ctesiphon, so that the frontier fell back to the Euphrates. There the war ended, and the empire's military centre of gravity swung back to the Danube. Historians may call it another Roman victory, but in strategic terms each side returned to where it had started: Rome kept the screen of Cappadocia, Parthia kept its suzerainty over Armenia, and neither got the valley. The Parthian horse-archers still rode between the Tigris and the Euphrates, while Rome had learned not to meet them head-on — and that is the real lesson this war left behind.
